h: Scouting the Land Through Wisdom Fear and Sacred Vision

p: and let them scout the land of Canaan…" (Bamidbar 13:2).
To understand the matter of sending the spies:
yet here he selected wise men
and heads of the Children of Yisrael.
"And the Ark of the covenant of Hashem journeyed before them
to seek out a resting place for them."
of which the Avos, Avraham, Yitzchak and Yaakov,
and they stand against the three kelipos,
which is "the Ark of the covenant of Hashem":
to purify them of all three kelipos,
and that they would enter Eretz Yisrael immediately.
who are also the aspect of an ark,
of which it is written, "Inside and outside you shall overlay it":
whose inside is not like his outside…" and so on.
for within him is the Torah she'b'al peh.
And they wanted these to refine them
to purify them of the three kelipos
And this is what it says:
"and let them scout the land of Canaan."
And this is what Chazal said (Sotah 34b):
"'Send for yourself' — of your own judgment";
but Yisrael are saying…" and so on.
through the aspect of the Written Torah
and this is akin to Torah she'b'al peh.
And this is why it says "of your own judgment,"
עַל דֶּרֶךְ מַה שֶּׁכָּתַב הַמָּגֵן אַבְרָהָם
in the manner of what the Magen Avraham wrote
how do we say on Shavuos,
which is the fiftieth day of the count,
"the time of the giving of our Torah,"
on the fifty-first day of the count?
And he answered that it comes to hint at
the second Yom Tov of the Diaspora;
"Perhaps this is what is meant by
'Moshe added one day of his own judgment.'"
is the aspect of Torah she'b'al peh,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתַב הָרַמְבַּ״ן (בָּבָא בַּתְרָא יב, ב)
and Rashi in Parshas Ki Sisa (Shemos 31:3)
And this is what it says, "Send for yourself, of your own judgment":
from the root of Torah she'b'al peh;
that it should be a mitzvah.
For from the side of Hashem Yisbarach
"And the Ark of the covenant of Hashem journeyed…,"
which is through the Written Torah,
And as for what it says,
וַיִּשְׁלַח אוֹתָם מֹשֶׁה עַל פִּי ה׳
"And Moshe sent them by the word of Hashem"
it is according to what is said
and it becomes the mouth of Hashem;
and this is the attribute of Shabbos:
we call it Torah she'b'al peh."
And this is why it says "by the word of Hashem,"
which is the aspect of Torah she'b'al peh;
for had Hashem Yisbarach commanded it,
it would have been a mitzvah and Written Torah.
But since it was said to him,
"Send for yourself, of your own judgment,"
by the word of Hashem," as said.
this is according to what we find
"He set his eyes upon him and he became…" and so on;
there is either death or poverty";
and the measure of good is greater,
so that they can bring in
they would bring holiness into the land.
And he commanded them to see
וְאָמַר וּרְאִיתֶם אֶת הָאָרֶץ מַה הִוא
He said, "And see the land, what it is,
and the people who dwell upon it";
and regarding the people he said,
whether it is few or many."
the root of the kelipos is two:
which is the refuse of the attribute of Gevurah
the kelipah of jealousy and murder;
and about this he told them,
the refuse of the attribute of Gedulah
of Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him,
And all the other kelipos of the nations
are included in these two kelipos,
And he said, "What is the land
וְהוּא עַל דֶּרֶךְ מַה שֶּׁנֶּאֱמַר (וַיִּקְרָא יח, כז)
and it is in the manner of what is said (Vayikra 18:27):
כִּי אֶת כָּל הַתּוֹעֵבוֹת הָאֵל עָשׂוּ וְגוֹ׳
for they brought impurity into the land.
And this is why the pasuk is precise:
impurity from their kelipah into the land.
that is, whether they defiled it, Heaven forbid.
And likewise, "And what are the cities
are they open camps or fortresses?"
That is, in the manner of what we find
that is, there is the holiness of the land
So too, one opposite the other, in the kelipah:
the kelipah there is more impure.
And this is what it says,
whether they brought impurity into the land,
whether the kelipah is in open camps
to the holiness of the land itself:
"is there a tree in it or not?"
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ג קנז, א)
as is written in the holy Zohar (Zohar III 157a):
"This is the Tree of Life…" and so on;
That is, the portion of Moshe Rabbeinu
is the aspect of the Written Torah,
וְהַיְינוּ כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ג קנח, ב)
and this is as is written in the holy Zohar (Zohar III 158b):
that the fruit of the land is greater
from the root of Torah she'b'al peh,
which is the portion of Yehoshua,

p: "And strengthen yourselves and take of the fruit of the land."
That is, for this one needs
namely the attribute of fear of Heaven:
to be "a mighty one who conquers his yetzer"
to take of the fruit of the land.
And the holy Zohar says there:
That is, they had to repair
from the aspect of the Tree of Knowledge of good and evil,
so that it would become "very good."
And for this strength and might are needed,
and it is the seventh attribute,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (הַקְדָּמָה ה, ב)
as is written in the holy Zohar (Introduction, 5b);
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ג קס, א)
as is written in the holy Zohar (Zohar III 160a):
wants nothing from us but the heart;
about those who occupy themselves with Torah
and have no fear of Heaven.
forever they shall inherit the land'";
namely, "a mighty one who conquers his yetzer."
is through the attribute of fear,
(פֶּרֶק הָרוֹאֶה, הוּבָא בְּתוֹסָפוֹת סוֹטָה כב, ב)
for if you come to rebel,
and one who fears does not rebel."
they did not need to strengthen themselves
so much in the attribute of fear.
And this is what is expounded about them
(Bamidbar Rabbah and Tanchuma on this parshah)
"One who sends a message by the hand of a fool":
וְהוּא עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁאָמַר בַּגְּמָרָא
And this is according to what the Gemara says
לָמָּה זֶּה מְחִיר בְּיַד כְּסִיל וְכוּלֵּי
"'Why is there a price in the hand of a fool…'" and so on,
"and they have no fear of Heaven";
for one who lacks fear of Heaven
take of the fruit of the land,
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ג קס, ב)
as is written in the holy Zohar (Zohar III 160b).
had the attribute of might and fear,
and had a connection to the fruit of the land.
And this is what the holy Zohar says:
That is, since they were able
to take of the fruit of the land,
as it is written, "And strengthen yourselves and take…,"
which is "a mighty one who conquers his yetzer,"
they knew that they would have
forever they shall inherit the land."

rich.text: “ומה הארץ השמנה הוא אם רזה הישבה עץ אם אין והתחזקתם ולקחתם מפרי הארץ והימים ימי בכורי ענבים”
— “Is the soil rich or poor? Is it wooded or not? And take pains to bring back some of the fruit of the land.”—Now it happened to be the season of the first ripe grapes.”
